resampling.sampling_frame: Sorted union of canonical genes with finite overlap_at_N in either populated annotated endpoint.
resampling.draw: Sample G gene indices uniformly with replacement, where G is the number of union genes. Give every retained row of each gene across contexts and both endpoints the same draw multiplicity.
resampling.statistic: Weighted sum of high-level scores divided by high-level row count minus corresponding low-level mean. Multiplicity replicates whole genes, not separately sampled endpoint groups or equally weighted gene means.
resampling.undefined_draw: Retain NaN and record invalid draw when either endpoint has no rows; compute CI from finite draws; do not impute zero.
resampling.conditioning: Observed contexts, fixed reference/annotations/levels; no resampling of contexts or new independent validation.
